data.translation: These are ways for us to create opportunities for our people, or to found institutions, to give them education.

data.translation: Uh, you founded 'Beṯ-Sefro, Institut d Beṯ-Nahrin' [House of Books, Institute of Mesopotamia], as you said at the beginning when you spoke about it.

rationale: Thin Preterit cell; explicit second-person L-agent and institution object, directly illustrating inherited gründen.

data.translation: Second, when our people came to Sweden, they founded associations, they founded unions.
